description: This file defines a generic Java interface named DataPopulator for data conversion or population between sources and targets, with methods that involve populating data using merchant store and language context.

classes.name: DataPopulator
classes.description: A generic interface for populating or converting data from a source to a target with context of merchant store and language, allowing implementations to define specific behaviors.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates data from the source object into the target object within the context of merchant store and language, potentially throwing a ConversionException.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates data from the source object into a new target object within the context of merchant store and language, potentially throwing a ConversionException.
